Initial Oral Dose: 70mg (First Dissociative Experience Ever)
I felt very anesthetized & relaxed (15 minutes) from initial oral dose of 70mg.
30 Minutes in and I was already feeling very anesthetically numb, euphoric and blissful and music was sounding amazing, appreciation of music was profound and the grandness of the music had amplified so much. I was still fully functional and could get away with looking sober. I was encompassed in anesthetic bliss while listening to my favorite music and I loved it. (I personally had no visuals.)
I believe this was the peak 30 minutes in and could see the experience going no further. According to (PsychonautWiki) I was in their range at the time of a common dose which was 65-100mg.
I dosed another 30mg orally bringing the total to 100mg Diphenidine which starts another 15 minute come-up from my original dose of 70mg. After the second dose kicked in on top of the first music was absolutely amazing! I was so relaxed, music felt much grander in scale still and with the euphoric anesthetic numbness I was feeling I fell into a musical binge for another hour until the experience ended.
The total duration of the entire experience for me was (2 hours) after that it felt like a slow come-down back to baseline. Music started to slowly go back to how it would normally sound and I lost my anesthesia. One negative I found was lots of jaw movement and bruxism noticed mostly after the end of the experience, but during also however less noticeable during the experience. I was chewing gum as soon as I noticed it though.
I personally had no tolerance to dissociates when conducting this experiment & this is my 1st personal experience with Diphenidine.
